versions.changelog: Added esc()/num(): every rendered string is HTML-escaped and every number coerced; Key now goes in the x-goog-api-key header; Split into separate slots: 'anthropic' (setup-token, no generic env var) and 'anthropic-admin' (TOKEN_PANEL_AN; Helpers now run by absolute path from /usr/bin or /bin only; Refuses a symlinked directory or file; Token compared with hmac; User-Agent is now token-panel-ultimate/2; Unit file text is now inside BUDGET_README as a heredoc
Reject symlink DB/JSON paths; force 0600/0700; user-level systemd only.
Keychain-only first-party credentials; no Claude Code store; counts-only persistence.

Removes hardcoded host paths from the browser widget (paths now derive from your home directory) and restores the TinkerClaw provenance banner and funnel link that were dropped in the previous revision.
Removed cross-application credential reuse. Provider keys are now first-party, keychain-backed, revocable, and never read from Claude Code or OpenClaw stores.

Applies the fix that cleared outlook-hack. Reading Claude Code's own credential file is now opt-in behind TOKEN_PANEL_USE_CLAUDE_CREDENTIALS=1, with an explanation of exactly what is read and why; the collector refuses otherwise and every other provider works from a key you supply. Adds an ownership check on the credential file. The token stays in memory for a single call to Anthropic's usage endpoint and is never stored, cached or forwarded.
Mutating localhost API endpoints require TOKEN_PANEL_API_TOKEN. Silent credential-file fallbacks remain removed. CORS stays localhost-only.
Remove silent ~/.openclaw/.env and openclaw.json credential fallbacks; localhost API CORS is origin-restricted instead of wildcard; keys come from the environment only.

Security pass — first update since June. Raises the fastapi floor to 0.109.1 (the previous >=0.100.0 permitted a release affected by CVE-2024-24762) and bounds every dependency below the next major. Removes silent secrets scraping: the OPENAI_API_KEY fallback no longer reads ~/.openclaw/.env on its own — a secrets file is read only if you name it in OPENAI_ENV_FILE, and it must be absolute, non-symlink and owner-only 0600. Session-transcript parsing is now opt-in behind TOKEN_PANEL_READ_TRANSCRIPTS=1 and refuses otherwise. Browser-widget console diagnostics gated behind BP_DEBUG. Adds a permissions block and states plainly that the Claude collector reads Claude Code's own credential store. Drops a vestigial package.json openclaw key that duplicated SKILL.md frontmatter.
